question: Which of the following articles of the Constitution of India is related to the promotion of co-operative societies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**43 B**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 43 B**:

 
 
• According to **Article 43 B** of the Constitution of India, the **State shall endeavor to promote voluntary formation, autonomous functioning, democratic control and professional management of cooperative societies**.
 
• Article 43 B is included in **Part IV** of the constitution.
